## Content overview

This week, we will focus on the Unix shell, and you will learn to use Unix
shell commands to:

#### [**Working with files in the Unix shell I: The shell as a file browser**](./w3_1_shellfiles.qmd) (Tuesday)

- Create, copy, move, rename and delete directories and files

<hr style="height:1pt; visibility:hidden;" />

#### [**Working with files in the Unix shell II: Viewing, summarizing and manipulating files**](./w3_2_shellfiles.qmd) (Thursday)

- View the contents of text files in various ways
- Search within, manipulate, and extract information from text files
